why.title: Compounding value instead of repeating experiments
why.body: Once an AI capability proves value in one part of the organisation, the question is how to extend it without rebuilding each time. Platform thinking — shared foundations, reusable capabilities and common governance — separates organisations that compound their investments from those that repeat expensive experimentation indefinitely.
